title: Representative Workload Sentinel: hardware matrix p95 & cost normalization
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create a reproducible 'sentinel' benchmarking harness that runs representative production-like workloads across the hardware matrix (A10, L4, A100, H100). The harness should: 1) run deterministic replay of sampled production traces and a curated battery of synthetic tails/bursts, 2) collect tokens/sec, p50/p95/p99 latency, and token egress counts, 3) compute normalized cost-per-token (USD) using current price sheet and amortized GPU utilization, and 4) feed metrics into the regression detector and runtime telemetry for regression alerts. Deliverables: harness code, CI job schedule, dashboard with heatmaps (throughput, p95, cost-per-token) and a runbook for triage and rollback criteria.
acceptance_criteria: Scheduled CI job that runs nightly across A10/L4/A100/H100 and uploads metrics to /dashboards/runtime/hw-sentinel
p95 regression detector configured with baseline window and alert thresholds; alerts create a Linear regression ticket automatically
Cost-per-token calculation implemented and documented; values align within 5% of manual spreadsheet for all GPUs
Replay harness supports: production trace sampling, synthetic burst profiles (spike/steady/step), and seed-controlled randomness
Runbook describing triage steps (investigate model variant, routing policy, batching change, quantization) and regression rollback policy is added to Confluence
implementation_notes: Leverage existing tokenflow harness code but replace synthetic-only generator with replay adapter that anonymizes traces and preserves length/temperature distributions
Normalize cost using: (total_gpu_hours * gpu_hour_price + amortized infra) / total_tokens_generated. Store price sheet in secrets manager and expose via /config/pricing endpoint
Use change-point detection + EWMA for p95 baseline drift detection. Keep alerts conservative at first (3 sigma) then tighten after 2 weeks of stable runs
Run each job with 3 independent seeds to estimate variability; aggregate median and 90th percentile across seeds
Limit per-run concurrency to match production concurrency percentiles: P50, P75, P95 profiles to measure batching effects

decisions: Use production-sampled replay instead of fully synthetic workloads to surface realistic KV-cache hit patterns and prefix reuse
Normalize costs to USD using current list-prices + negotiated reserved discounts stored in pricing config
Run early detection at conservative thresholds to build trust; after two weeks, tighten thresholds and enable auto-ticketing
Store raw per-request traces for 7 days and aggregated histograms for 90 days to support exploratory debugging without PII exposure
